name: Order
description: The Order page: every card's front and back as they'll be printed, what's still missing before ordering, copies, card stock and foil, a proof sheet – and Send to MPC, which fills your whole MakePlayingCards order with mpc-autofill (it offers to get the mpc-autofill add-on the first time). Real cards get MPCFill's print-ready pictures once you set up an MPCFill server (MPCFill… on the page), Scryfall's otherwise. Until MSE Studio 0.25 this page came with the app.
author: MEZTKING
